placement.reason: The recurring glass-block loft is established as Craig and Gina’s home, where Eddie stays in their storage room. The official episode identifies the interior and doorway but does not establish a street number. Its real production site and whether the interior was a location or studio construction remain unverified. It is distinct from both the pilot apartment and Mitch’s Sherman Canal house.

audit.decision: Keep this record outside places[] until an actual production site is identified. No marker or real-site photograph has been invented.

audit.identity: User confirmed the recurring glass-block loft where Eddie stays, not the different beach apartment seen in the pilot.

audit.official_episode_review: The In Deep upload cuts from the Venice boardwalk to a tight wooden doorway, then the distinctive white-steel/glass-block loft. The transition has no identifiable street facade or number. Frames were extracted from the official upload, not a fan montage.

audit.geography: The episode review calls the story home a Venice loft. Primary distributor summaries establish the residents and recurring housesitting, but do not provide an address.

audit.production_uncertainty: Mitch’s documented studio-set history is not evidence that Craig’s loft is also a set. Neither a location address nor a studio claim is asserted.

audit.archive_research: The live MovieShotsLA domain does not resolve. Internet Archive CDX returned392 distinct2007–2015 HTML URLs and no Baywatch-named URL. The archived2013home/television index and early all-categories, Venice Canals, and filming-locations categories were inspected. The2013television index contains no items; the old canal gallery uses generic photo labels without identifying this loft.

missing_evidence: Matched exterior or current/archival real-site photograph

audit.crew_search: Production-designer credits for the first season name Ray Storey and John Leimanis. Focused public interview/book/location searches found no loft-specific statement establishing a street address or studio construction. These general credits cannot support a specific-site attribution.
